reason: A coding-agent skill that analyzes repository structure and routes proposed changes to existing capabilities while enforcing reuse, ownership, dependency, and write-boundary governance.

summaries.zh: 面向编码智能体分析大型仓库的能力边界，并在修改代码前提供变更路由、复用建议和写入约束。
summaries.en: A coding-agent skill that analyzes large repository boundaries and provides change routing, reuse guidance, and write constraints before code edits.

capabilities: Analyzes repository structure, ownership, capability boundaries, dependencies, and public APIs
Produces change-routing reports with reuse guidance, write constraints, and execution gates
Generates a local project-change-router bundle and can install skill files for supported coding agents
Can append routing hints to Codex and Claude Code instruction files when explicitly installed with hint injection
